issues.claim: V09 §4.21.12 (5) (l.3617–3619) frames the crisis card's Show by "the look's place — its camps, or for a `disaster` look the union of its units' `FindArea` shapes (V01 §5.4 (6))", and (7)'s Find Go to "frames it as the card's Show does". Six of §10.2's twelve look kinds take no camp land and are not `disaster` — `famine` (`fields`), `beast` (`edge`), `raiders` (`outlyingFarms`), `rebellion`, `boom` and `bust` (`streets`) (V11 §3.25.9 l.4531–4537: "the other looks take no camp land") — so their Show and Go to have no stated frame; and nothing gives V09 one look's camps either (`LooksAnswer.crises[]` carries no extent; §2.9's crisis framing is the union over every look). Round 3 closed the `disaster` case only (R3-16 (b)); the adjudicator graded that same gap MAJOR.
issues.required_change: V09 §4.21.12 (5)'s Show reads "**Show**, framing the look's place — the box of the marks `live.crises` draws for that look (§8.2's look rows, keyed by its condition, a preview by its look kind: its camps, siege line and engines, its bare fields, torn edge runs, burned farmsteads, barricades, scaffolds or shutters, and its massed marks on §8.8's ring), or for a `disaster` look the union of its units' `FindArea` shapes (V01 §5.4 (6)) — as **Fit the town** frames the town"; §1b's crisis-lines row (l.377) adds the input "`live.crises`'s marks by look (§8.2), for **Show**'s frame"; §3.16 row 91 adds the edge "**Show** on a look that takes no camp land (a famine, a rebellion)" with the outcome "framed on the marks drawn for it"; T-V9-85 adds "a previewed `famine`'s and `rebellion`'s **Show** framing their bare fields and their barricades".

issues.claim: R3-10 rules that a disaster look leaves each building in the week V06 §3.22 (3)'s `crisisLookYields` turns true on it (a Works other than a `decay` Works begun on it), a preview never handing over; the base (§8.2 l.13013–13016, §8.6 l.13986, §10.2 (f) l.15575), V03 §5.6 (4) (l.2726), V02 §5.7, V01 §3.16 and V10 (§3.9a l.1852–1855; §3.9b (8) l.2020–2025, "the drawn ruin leaving with the condition or its rebuilding Works") all state it. V09 states it nowhere (0 hits of `crisisLookYields`, "reconstruction" or a hand-over): §4.21.12 (4) (l.3604–3609) puts `info.crisis.ruinedFor` on the why card "of a building in a district a disaster look ruins"; §4.21.13 (3) (l.3668–3673) has the plan panel show "the building's lines at the look's `lookLevel` … under the head `info.crisis.ruinedFor`" for every building of such a district; §5.8 (l.3951–3953) likewise; row 92 and T-V9-86 test no handed-over building; §2.12's crisis-card row (l.1005) re-reads only "at each week change, absorb and `onEffectiveKey`" (a commit that begins a Works is no trigger) and its damage-lines row (l.1008) not at a change of the `crises` key. For a building whose rebuild Works has begun, V09's panel and card show the ruin and "For now: Ruined quarters, …" while the map draws its scaffolding (§8.2) and the clerk says the look has left it (V10): two outcomes for one case (R3-03 (b)).
issues.required_change: V09 §4.21.12 (4): "… as a `facts` row on the why card of a building a disaster look still draws ruined — one of the look's `districts` in §11.2's `looks` reader (…), not yet handed over to its rebuilding (V06 §3.22 (3)'s `crisisLookYields`, evaluated in the generation worker: the look's `yielded` buildings; a preview never hands over) — or of a field a famine leaves bare …"; §4.21.13 (3): "In a district a disaster look ruins, until the look leaves the building (V06 §3.22 (3)'s `crisisLookYields`: a Works other than a `decay` Works begun on it; a preview never hands over), the plan panel (V03 §4.5) shows …; once it has left, the panel shows the building's own level's lines and the card no `info.crisis.ruinedFor` row (V03 §5.6 (4); V10 §3.9a)"; §5.8's "for a building in a district a disaster look ruins" reads "for a building a disaster look still draws ruined (V09 §4.21.12 (4))"; §2.12's crisis-card row adds "each `doc.changed`" to its triggers and its damage-lines row "each change of the `crises` key"; §3.16 row 92 adds the edge "a building of the district whose rebuilding Works has begun" with the outcome "its own level's lines, no look, no `info.crisis.ruinedFor`"; T-V9-86 adds "a building of the disaster's district under its `reconstruction` Works shows its own level's lines and no `info.crisis.ruinedFor`, and under a `disaster` preview the look". END (rendering): §11.2's `LooksAnswer.crises[]` gains `yielded?: Id[] /* a disaster look: the buildings of its districts V06 §3.22 (3)'s crisisLookYields has handed over at the drawn week; key-filtered; absent on a preview */`.

issues.claim: V10 §2.13's `LookAnswer.festivals` (l.1000–1001) projects §11.2's `LooksAnswer.festivals`, its `name` commented "a dossier tradition's (V08 §3.16 (5)); a standalone generic festival, which it names not"; §3.9b (5) (l.1946–1948) calls it "the list V09 §4.21.8 reads"; T-V10-49 asserts `read_map look` returns "the festival list the view shows". But the base's `LooksAnswer.festivals` is "DR43's list" (l.16159) and DR43 holds "standalone no tradition exists and none is invented" (l.11980); V11's registry row 105 gives `festival.generic` to "V09's preview list, standalone" and the renderer directly (V11 l.1030); V09 §4.21.8 (1) lists the generic festivals standalone (T-V9-78: "standalone, the four generic festivals are listed"). On a standalone map the look read so returns no festival while the panel shows four, and T-V10-49 cannot pass against a base-conformant build. V10's round-3 HAND-OFFS name the gap; the base, V09 and V11 agree with each other, so V10 is the end that moves.
issues.required_change: V10 §2.13's `name` comment reads "LooksAnswer's `name` — a dossier tradition's (V08 §3.16 (5)); the list is DR43's, so a standalone map's is empty (no tradition exists, DR43), a previewed generic festival (V11 §3.25.7's `festival.generic`) reaching the model only through `display.id`, rendered in V09's `view.festival.<id>` words"; §3.9b (5)'s "(`LooksAnswer.festivals`: §7.7's DR43, the list V09 §4.21.8 reads, under the session's key)" reads "(`LooksAnswer.festivals`: §7.7's DR43, the dossier's festivals V09 §4.21.8 lists, under the session's key; standalone none, a previewed generic festival named from the display)"; T-V10-49's "the festival list the view shows" reads "the dossier's festival list the view shows (§11.2's `LooksAnswer.festivals`), and on a standalone fixture no festival, a previewed generic one named in V09's words".
